id.description: Unique station identifier, e.g. stn_hwh or stn_12345

name.description: Station English display name, e.g. Howrah Junction

name_bn.description: Bengali script station name, e.g. হাওড়া জংশন

code.description: Indian Railways station code or Metro code, e.g. HWH, SDAH

kind.description: Transit category: suburban/long-distance rail vs urban subway

network.description: Operating network, e.g. Eastern Railway, South Eastern Railway, Kolkata Metro

lines.description: Suburban divisions or metro line identifiers
